transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Um… mostly work stuff. I keep getting up from my station when I’m supposed to stay there, or I’ll pop up in meetings without really meaning to. My supervisor said it’s turning into a safety issue because I kind of take off before I think.
Do you find it hard to stay seated or feel restless when you're supposed to stay in one place?

Yeah… I do. I keep getting up when I’m supposed to stay at my station, and in meetings I’ll just kind of pop up. I don’t really think first, I just do it. My supervisor’s been saying it’s becoming a safety problem.
Do you find yourself acting on impulse or having trouble staying seated in situations outside of work, like at home or in social settings?

Yeah… I mean, it’s mostly the work stuff that got me here. I keep leaving my station or standing up in meetings when I’m supposed to stay put. I don’t really stop and think first, I just kind of go, and my supervisor said it’s getting unsafe.
Do you also find yourself getting up frequently or acting impulsively in places other than work, like at home, in public, or during social gatherings?

Mostly it’s been at work. Like I said, I keep leaving my station or standing up in meetings when I’m supposed to stay put. I just… move before I really think about it. My supervisor says it’s getting to be a safety issue.
Do you find yourself getting up frequently or acting impulsively in places other than work, like at home, in public, or during social gatherings?

Not really much outside work that I can think of. The main thing is at work — leaving my station or standing up in meetings when I’m supposed to stay put. I kind of just take off before I think, and my supervisor says it’s becoming a safety problem.
Do you often have trouble focusing on tasks, feel easily distracted, or find it hard to wait your turn in situations where patience is required?

Yeah… focusing is hard, especially on the line. Like, if another machine beeps or somebody goes by with a pallet jack, I’ll look over and then my whole mind is off what I’m supposed to be doing. Even when I know I’m supposed to stay on my own station.

Outside of work, have you had similar issues with staying focused, being easily distracted, or having trouble waiting your turn — like at home, in social situations, or during school or other activities?

I mean… it’s mostly on the line. Like if another machine beeps or somebody walks by with a pallet jack, I’ll look over and then my mind’s just off what I’m doing. Even when I know I’m supposed to stay on my own station.
